svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Check the forecast for the entire week at the destination when planning a trip, before dec
iding on activities and buying tickets. → Plan outdoor activities with friends based on th
e weather, buying tickets for them only when the forecast is suitable.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Receive notifications or alerts for extreme weather conditions. → See extreme weather cond
itions (thunderstorm, flooding) in the app so as to postpone the planned event and not go

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Receive routine weather notifications about three times a day (morning, afternoon, evening
) aligned with going-out times, instead of constant pop-ups. → Use a daily forecast rather
than a weekly forecast for routine weather checks.
